title: neckia lancifolia f. major
intro: Neckia lancifolia f. major, commonly known as "Mountain Mint", is a plant species in the Lamiaceae family, characterized by its fragrant leaves and stems. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as relief from digestive issues, reduction of inflammation, and antimicrobial effects. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to act as an antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Neckia lancifolia f. major include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
